snapshot.title: GCS-01 Backup Radio Link Failure — UAS-02

fields.subject: Backup 461.0375 MHz Radio Link on GCS-01 Not Activated During UAS-02 Link Loss
fields.description: The 461.0375 MHz backup radio link on GCS-01 shows no signal from UAS-02. The channel was not activated during the link loss event. The radio's failover status is 'disabled' in the GCS-01 console log (file: \HUOG-NAS01\ops\link-logs\2026-10-15\GCS-01-link-trace.txt). The firmware update accepted at 08:55:12 altered the failover logic to prevent automatic activation of the 461.0375 MHz channel, even when the primary C2 link (915 MHz) fails. This change was not documented in the GCS-01 parameter export or the HUOG-FOM 4.3 configuration baseline.

activity.author: Field Technician – Hangar 2
activity.text: Verified that 461.0375 MHz radio on GCS-01 is powered and configured, but failover status shows 'disabled' in the log. No manual override was attempted. Link loss persists. UAS-02 remains unresponsive at 398 ft AGL.

activity.author: Systems & Cybersecurity Lead (SCL)
activity.text: Ticket auto-assigned to Systems & Cybersecurity Lead (SCL) due to high impact on UAS-02 flight integrity and potential cyber compromise.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms the firmware update altered the failover logic. The technical team must trace the change to the update package and verify if the GCS-01 configuration was tampered with. Watch for attempts to override the disabled failover status.
